svg.text: OzAgriMate Runtime Diagram 1 - Telemetry submission and processing (UML sequence)
Telemetry container | prototype implements steps 4-16 and the idempotent replay (19-21); dashed boxes are target containers; amber steps are planned
opt [uplink outage] - edge buffering planned; idempotent replay implemented
async, PLANNED - broker relay and consumption; the prototype keeps an in-memory outbox
2. Normalise to schema v1; assign readingId
11. Last accepted value for this device
17. Hold readings up to 72 h while offline
20. Original record [not stored or published again]
24. Skip seen eventId; evaluate alert rules
Quarantined readings (step 12) are stored with reason codes but never published, so they cannot trigger irrigation or alerts (ASR5).
The gateway receives 201 once the reading is stored; downstream processing is asynchronous and scales separately (ADR-02).
Prototype: no edge gateway or broker. Postman calls the REST Controller directly at 127.0.0.1:8002, standing in for steps 3, 16, 18 and 21.
